name: Program Management Professional
name_ja: プログラムマネジメント・プロフェッショナル

logistics.format: Panel review of professional experience followed by computer-based multiple-choice exam at Pearson VUE

formal: Four-year degree + 48 months project management experience + 84 months program management experience (within last 15 years), OR
Secondary degree + 48 months project management experience + 96 months program management experience

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 3. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded extensive project/program experience and panel review support expert organizational program direction; nontechnical scope means this does not validate specialist cybersecurity delivery.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Extensive verified program and project experience plus panel review support expert organizational program responsibility. The nontechnical focus means this is leadership evidence rather than a SOC or pentest skill filter.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded eleven-year profile and panel review of substantial program experience provide credible evidence of senior direction across projects. Expert fits that program-governance track, while the credential does not establish technical security ability.
